group_manifest.proof_strategy: Choose l_strong_spec, l1_strong_spec, and l2_strong_spec from the visible list decomposition: prefix/[node]/nil for tail, nil/[node]/suffix for front, and the prefix/suffix returned by xizi_sll_remove_first_split__spec_derivations_direct for member. Derive node non-nullness from xizi_sll_head plus membership via xizi_sll_member_split. Under the wand antecedent, substitute retval and the successor pointer, convert the concrete points-to cell to xizi_sll_node with store_ptr_undef_store_ptr, and normalize app/remove_first equalities. The only case-specific mathematical helper is already proved in the seed case_lib.

group_entry.grouping_reason: These three witnesses all derive a public remove contract from strong_spec by choosing a prefix/node/suffix decomposition and proving the same magic-wand continuation. They use one shared membership/non-nullness and node-resource conversion pattern. This is the smallest coherent second group and has 3 witnesses, below the limit of 12.
group_entry.proof_strategy: Choose l_strong_spec, l1_strong_spec, and l2_strong_spec from the visible list decomposition: prefix/[node]/nil for tail, nil/[node]/suffix for front, and the prefix/suffix returned by xizi_sll_remove_first_split__spec_derivations_direct for member. Derive node non-nullness from xizi_sll_head plus membership via xizi_sll_member_split. group_entry.natural_language_proof_pattern: Instantiate strong_spec with a concrete prefix-node-suffix split, prove the removed node is non-null from list membership, then discharge the shared wand by preserving the shortened head predicate and weakening the removed node's next-field ownership to xizi_sll_node.
proving_hints: tail: choose l1_strong_spec = prefix_remove_tail_spec and l2_strong_spec = nil; membership is by in_or_app on the final singleton, and app_nil_r closes the shortened list equality.
front: choose l1_strong_spec = nil and l2_strong_spec = suffix_remove_front_spec; membership is at the head and simpl closes the list equalities.

member: apply existing xizi_sll_remove_first_split__spec_derivations_direct to In linklist_node_pre l_remove_member_spec; choose its prefix/suffix and rewrite the returned remove-first equality after discharging the wand.
For every witness, use xizi_sll_member_split only to extract node <> NULL and use store_ptr_undef_store_ptr to build xizi_sll_node; no new helper declaration is required.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_SingleLinkListRmNode_derive_rem: Instantiate the decomposition as prefix_remove_tail_spec ++ [linklist_node_pre]; show membership/non-nullness, then the wand removes the final node and app_nil_r yields the tail postcondition.
Instantiate prefix = nil and suffix = suffix_remove_front_spec; the wand consumes the returned target cell into xizi_sll_node and leaves the suffix head predicate.
Use the proved remove-first split lemma to obtain prefix/suffix and xizi_sll_remove_first equality, then follow the shared wand/node proof and rewrite that equality.
